required_concepts: multiplication of numbers ending in certain digits
acceptable_paraphrases: The square of a number ending in 3 results in a product ending in 9
critical_errors: Incorrect calculation of the power or modulus operation
Misinterpreting the base and exponent values
misconceptions: Believing the last digit is determined by the first digit of the number (753)
Incorrectly thinking the power operation affects the base 753 instead of focusing on the units place (3)
Forgetting to consider modular arithmetic or only focusing on full powers without considering last digits
grading_notes: Points should be awarded for correct use of keywords and concepts. Partial credit can be given for partial understanding, but critical errors must result in deduction.
